notebook:
Turn 41, solves 49/50 after this. Best valid = 0.000 (empty plant). All cascades so far negative: column costs 100-365M/yr, revenues ~0 (never reached 95% purity).

Lessons:
- Cost ~0.11 M/yr per mol/s at 40st R=6; 60st R=6 = $244.6M/yr.
- Revenue = flow*2.88e7*price. nC4 450 mol/s=166M; nC5 442=439M; iC5 253=280M.
- Blends: C6 paraffin 1182M, C5 618M, C6 naphthene 396M, C4 186M, C3 73M — all need near-perfect multicut separation, far above cost.
- Single-column cuts can't reach 95%: C4/C5 tops ~63% C4; C3/C4 tops carries C2.
- Side draw must not sit on feed stage (30 for 60-stage col).
Conclusion: economics don't support separation at this cost level; empty plant 0.000 likely best. Trying one 2-col cascade then finishing.
